scope: regular-season games, WR / TE / RB on current rosters; TD = receiving + rushing

weighting.scheme: per-game season weights (recency tilt); weighted Pearson, Kish effective-N used for significance
weighting.copula: r = Gaussian-copula correlation: normal scores of the continuous stat within each season x polyserial factor for the count stat

shrinkage.method: empirical Bayes: weighted copula r shrunk toward rotation players at the same position; noise evaluated at the prior; tau held to 0.02-0.05
